:::{#thm-sample-mean-expectation}
#### The expectation of a sample average

Let $\dsn{X}$ be random variables that each have mean $\mean$,
and let $\bar X \eqdef \avgin X_i$.
Then

$$\Ep[\bar X] = \mean$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-linearity-use.
By @thm-linearity-expectation,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Ep[\bar X]
&= \Ep\sb{\avgin X_i} \\
&= \avgin \Ep[X_i] \\
&= \frac{1}{n}\,(n\mean) \\
&= \mean
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
